logger.doc:name: Log Bad Request
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] Bad Request | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "BAD_REQUEST", errorCode: 400, message: "Invalid file format or malformed request", error: error.description default "Unknown error", correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Validation Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[WARN] Validation Error | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "VALIDATION_ERROR", errorCode: 422, message: "Data validation failed", error: error.description default "Unknown error", validationErrors: vars.validationErrors default [], correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log System Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] System Error | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "SYSTEM_ERROR", errorCode: 500, message: "Internal system error occurred", error: "Database connection or query execution failed", correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Unexpected Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] Unexpected Error | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "INTERNAL_ERROR", errorCode: 500, message: "An unexpected error occurred", error: error.description default "Unknown error", correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Request Received
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Request Received | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Endpoint: /upload-files | Method: POST | Timestamp: ' ++ (vars.requestStartTime as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log No Files
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] No Files Provided | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 input payload multipart/form-data output application/java --- payload.parts pluck (value, key) -> { partName: key, fileContent: value.content, contentType: value.headers.'Content-Type' default "", fileName: value.headers.'Content-Disposition'.filename default "" }

logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Files
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] No Valid Files Found | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

raise-error.description: No valid files found in request. Please upload CSV or Excel files.

logger.doc:name: Log Files Detected
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Files Detected | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | TotalFiles: ' ++ sizeOf(payload filter ($.fileName != '')) ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log File Processing Start
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] File Processing Started | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileNumber: ' ++ vars.fileCounter ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ payload.fileName ++ ' | StartTime: ' ++ (vars.fileStartTime as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log File Parsing Results
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] File Parsed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ payload.fileName ++ ' | FileType: ' ++ payload.fileType ++ ' | TotalRecords: ' ++ payload.totalRecords ++ ' | ValidRecords: ' ++ payload.validCount ++ ' | InvalidRecords: ' ++ payload.invalidCount ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Unsupported File Type
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] Unsupported File Type | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

raise-error.description: #['Unsupported file type: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ '. Only CSV and Excel files are supported.']

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Insert Start
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[WARN] DLQ Insert Started | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | InvalidRecordsCount: ' ++ vars.currentInvalidCount ++ ' | StartTime: ' ++ (vars.dlqStartTime as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.currentInvalidRecords map { source_id: $.source_id, name: $.name, email: $.email, age: $.age, error_message: $.errors joinBy ", ", file_name: vars.currentFileName }

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Batch Insert to DLQ
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO dead_letter_queue (source_id, name, email, age, error_message, file_name, created_at) VALUES (:source_id, :name, :email, :age, :error_message, :file_name, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Insert Success
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] DLQ Insert Completed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | RecordsInserted: ' ++ vars.currentInvalidCount ++ ' | ProcessingTime: ' ++ ((vars.dlqEndTime - vars.dlqStartTime) as Number) ++ 'ms | Timestamp: ' ++ (vars.dlqEndTime as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Batch Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] DLQ Insert Failed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | RecordsAttempted: ' ++ vars.currentInvalidCount ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Validation Start
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Validation Started | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | ValidRecordsCount: ' ++ vars.currentValidCount ++ ' | StartTime: ' ++ (vars.validationStartTime as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Duplicate Detection
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Duplicate Detection Completed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | DuplicatesFound: ' ++ vars.duplicateCount ++ ' | RecordsToInsert: ' ++ sizeOf(vars.recordsToInsert) ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

db:select.doc:name: Batch Check Emails in DB
db:select.db:sql: SELECT email FROM records WHERE email IN (:emailList)

logger.doc:name: Log DB Check Complete
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] DB Email Check Completed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | ExistingEmailsInDB: ' ++ sizeOf(vars.existingEmailsInDb) ++ ' | ProcessingTime: ' ++ ((now() - vars.dbCheckStartTime) as Number) ++ 'ms | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Insert Start
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Batch Insert Started | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | RecordsToInsert: ' ++ sizeOf(vars.finalRecordsToInsert) ++ ' | StartTime: ' ++ (vars.insertStartTime as String)]

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Batch Insert Records
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO records (source_id, name, email, age) VALUES (:source_id, :name, :email, :age) ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO NOTHING

logger.doc:name: Log Insert Success
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Batch Insert Completed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | RecordsInserted: ' ++ vars.insertedCount ++ ' | ProcessingTime: ' ++ ((vars.insertEndTime - vars.insertStartTime) as Number) ++ 'ms | Timestamp: ' ++ (vars.insertEndTime as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Batch Insert Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] Batch Insert Failed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | RecordsAttempted: ' ++ sizeOf(vars.finalRecordsToInsert) ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | ProcessingTime: ' ++ ((now() - vars.insertStartTime) as Number) ++ 'ms | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

try.doc:name: Try Store Failed Batch in DLQ

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.finalRecordsToInsert map { source_id: $.source_id, name: $.name, email: $.email, age: $.age, error_message: "Database batch insert failed: " ++ (error.description default "Unknown error"), file_name: vars.currentFileName }

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Batch Insert Failed to DLQ
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO dead_letter_queue (source_id, name, email, age, error_message, file_name, created_at) VALUES (:source_id, :name, :email, :age, :error_message, :file_name, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

logger.doc:name: Log Failed Records to DLQ
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Failed Records Stored in DLQ | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | FailedRecordsCount: ' ++ vars.failedCount ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Batch Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] Failed to Store Failed Records in DLQ | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log No Records to Insert
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] No Records to Insert | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Reason: All records are duplicates | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log All Duplicates
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] All Records Are Duplicates | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.fileResults + [{ fileName: vars.currentFileName, status: 'SUCCESS', processingTimeMs: vars.fileProcessingTime, totalRecordsInFile: vars.currentValidCount + vars.currentInvalidCount, validRecords: vars.currentValidCount, invalidRecords: vars.currentInvalidCount, duplicateRecords: (vars.duplicateCount default 0) + (vars.existingEmailCount default 0), recordsInserted: vars.insertedCount default 0, recordsFailed: vars.failedCount default 0, invalidDetails: vars.currentInvalidRecords map { row: $$.index + 1, name: $.name, email: $.email, age: $.age, errors: $.errors } }]

logger.doc:name: Log File Processing Complete
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] File Processing Completed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Status: SUCCESS | TotalRecords: ' ++ (vars.currentValidCount + vars.currentInvalidCount) ++ ' | ValidRecords: ' ++ vars.currentValidCount ++ ' | InvalidRecords: ' ++ vars.currentInvalidCount ++ ' | RecordsInserted: ' ++ (vars.insertedCount default 0) ++ ' | RecordsFailed: ' ++ (vars.failedCount default 0) ++ ' | ProcessingTime: ' ++ vars.fileProcessingTime ++ 'ms | Timestamp: ' ++ (vars.fileEndTime as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Validation Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] File Validation Error | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ (vars.currentFileName default 'unknown') ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (vars.errorTime as String)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.fileResults + [{ fileName: (vars.currentFileName default 'unknown'), status: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', errorCode: 422, message: error.description default "Unknown validation error", timestamp: vars.errorTime }]

logger.doc:name: Log Processing Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] File Processing Error | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ (vars.currentFileName default 'unknown') ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (vars.errorTime as String)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.fileResults + [{ fileName: (vars.currentFileName default 'unknown'), status: 'ERROR', errorCode: 500, message: error.description default "Unknown error", timestamp: vars.errorTime }]

logger.doc:name: Skip Non-File Part
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[DEBUG] Skipping Non-File Part | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | PartName: ' ++ payload.partName ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "COMPLETED", message: "Multiple file upload processed with batch validation and insertion", correlationId: correlationId, summary: { totalFilesProcessed: sizeOf(vars.fileResults), totalRecordsInserted: vars.totalRecords, totalValidRecords: vars.totalValid, totalInvalidRecords: vars.totalInvalid, totalFailedRecords: vars.totalFailed, totalProcessingTimeMs: vars.totalProcessingTime }, fileResults: vars.fileResults, timestamp: vars.requestEndTime }

logger.doc:name: Log Request Complete
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Request Completed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Status: COMPLETED | TotalFilesProcessed: ' ++ sizeOf(vars.fileResults) ++ ' | TotalRecordsInserted: ' ++ vars.totalRecords ++ ' | TotalValidRecords: ' ++ vars.totalValid ++ ' | TotalInvalidRecords: ' ++ vars.totalInvalid ++ ' | TotalFailedRecords: ' ++ vars.totalFailed ++ ' | TotalProcessingTime: ' ++ vars.totalProcessingTime ++ 'ms | Timestamp: ' ++ (vars.requestEndTime as String)]
